facts.business: Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL) is a Government of India Enterprise under the Ministry of Defence that manufactures Surface to Air Missiles (SAM), Air to Air Missiles (AAM), Anti-Tank Guided Missiles (ATGMs), Torpedoes, and Allied Defence Equipments.

capacity_or_capex.item: Additional facilities at Amaravati, Maharashtra, Ibrahimpatnam, Telangana and Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh

auditor.name: M/s. Tej Raj & Pal Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of matter on note 38(7) regarding inventory not moved for more than five years amounting to Rs 8,327.07 lakh for which no provision for redundancy was made as per company's accounting policy.

key_risks: Provision and contingent liabilities relating to ongoing litigations with significant amounts involved and high estimation uncertainty
